## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A sixteen-fascicle early-Qīng commentary on the *Sìfēn bǐqiū jièběn* 四分比丘戒本 ([KR6k0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0010)) compiled by **Dìngān Déjī** 定菴德基 ([德基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E5%9F%BA), 1634–1700/01), third-generation patriarch of **Bǎohuáshān Lǜzōng** 寶華山律宗 and dharma-heir of [讀體](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%AE%80%E9%AB%94) Jiànyuè Dútǐ. *Guānyào* 關要 ("the essential pivot") indicates a comprehensive practical study-manual rather than a strict textual commentary. The work supplies a thorough phrase-by-phrase exegesis of the *prātimokṣa* in the early-Qīng Bǎohuáshān manner and is paired with the companion glossary *Píní guānyào shìyì* 毗尼關要事義 ([KR6k0153](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0153)).

**Abstract**

The *Píní guānyào* is the principal **early-Qīng Bǎohuáshān** *Sìfēnlǜ* study manual, occupying for the early-Qīng monastic curriculum the position that Dàoxuān's *Sìfēnlǜ shānfán bǔquē xíngshì chāo* 四分律刪繁補闕行事鈔 had occupied for Tang and Sòng *Nánshān* monks. It systematises the practical implementation of the *prātimokṣa* under the institutional conditions of the Bǎohuáshān ordination platform — the dominant Vinaya-school institution of early-Qīng China — and absorbs the late-Míng Vinaya scholarship of [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) (the [KR6k0151](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0151) *Chóngzhì píní shìyì jíyào*) into a Bǎohuáshān framework. The companion *Shìyì* ([KR6k0153](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0153)) supplies the lexical and historical glosses for the names, places, and technical terms cited in the *Guānyào*. Composition cannot be precisely dated; it must postdate Déjī's succession to the abbacy after 1679 (Dútǐ's death) but precede his own death in 1700/01.
